body.p: The Git History view shows the commit history, revision graph, commit details, and affected resources for the selected repository, branch, or resource. The view opens at the bottom of the application interface. You can open it in any of the following ways:

ul.li: Use the Show current repository history action from the toolbar of the Git Staging view.
Go to Window Show View Git History .
Use the Show history contextual action in supported views and editors.

section.title: Main Areas
section.p: The Git History view is organized around the following areas:

dlentry.dd: Shows the repository name and the current branch.
Lets you choose which branches are shown, link the history with the current editor, refresh the view, and filter the commits by text.
Shows the revision graph, commit messages, dates, authors, and commit IDs. It also shows the Uncommitted changes entry when the working copy has local changes that are not committed.
Shows details for the selected commit, such as the commit ID, parent commit, author, date, committer, and commit message.
Lists the files changed by the selected commit.

section.title: Toolbar and Filter
section.p: Use the toolbar to control which commits are shown in the history table.

dlentry.dd:
Lets you choose which branches to show history for. You can choose one of the following options:
All branches - Shows the commits for all branches, both local and remote, including unpushed local and unpulled remote commits.
All local branches - Shows commits only for local branches, including unpushed local commits.
Current branch - Shows commits for the current branch, including unpushed local and unpulled remote commits.
Current local branch - Shows commits only for the current local branch, including unpushed local commits.
Synchronizes the history with the selected editor. It is enabled by default.
Filters the history by text that appears in any displayed column: Commit message, Date, Author, or Commit. The filter also matches branch and tag names shown in the Commit message column.

section.title: History Table
section.p: The history table shows commits in rows. The graph column shows how commits are connected, and the other columns show the commit message, date, author, and commit ID.
For each commit in the history table, the following contextual menu actions are available:

li.p: Create branch - Creates a branch from the selected commit. By default, a checkout is performed automatically for the new branch. To disable this behavior, deselect Checkout branch in the Create branch dialog box.To publish a new branch to the remote repository and start tracking that branch, push the local branch from the Git Staging view.

ul.li: Create tag - Creates a tag on the selected commit. You have the option to push the tag to the remote repository.
Merge - Merges the selected commit into the current branch. This integrates all changes from the selected commit and any of its ancestors that are not already in the current branch.
Cherry-pick - Applies the changes from the selected commit to the current branch.
Checkout - Performs a checkout of a branch at a specific commit, either in detached head form or by creating a branch at that commit.
Revert commit - Creates a commit that reverts all changes from the selected commit.
Reset "[branch_name]" to this commit - Moves the HEAD of the current branch to the selected commit.
Explain commit - Uses AI Positron to explain the changes from the selected commits.

section.title: Commit Details Pane
section.p: The commit details pane shows information about the selected commit. Use this pane to inspect the full commit ID, parent commit, author, date, committer, and commit message without opening another dialog box.

section.title: Affected Resources Pane
section.p: The affected resources pane lists the files changed by the selected commit. For each resource, the following contextual menu actions are available:

ul.li: Open (available for added and modified resources) - Opens the selected resource.
Open previous version (available for deleted resources) - Opens the version of the selected resource from before its deletion.
Open working copy version (available for added and modified resources) - Opens the working copy version of the selected resource. It also works if the resource was renamed between versions.

Reset file to this commit (available for added and modified resources) - Performs a checkout of the selected version of the resource and overwrites its current version. It does not work if the resource was renamed or deleted between versions.
Compare with previous version (available for modified resources) - Compares the selected version of the resource with the previous version using the Compare Files tool.
Compare with working copy version (available for modified resources) - Compares the selected version of the resource with the current version using the Compare Files tool.
Compare with each other (available when selecting two versions of a single file) - Compares the selected versions with each other using the Compare Files tool.
